name: SamCart
summary: Checkout pages and online sales platform.

flows.title: Connect a webhook from the App Marketplace
steps: Click Apps in the left-hand navigation bar to open the App Marketplace.
Search for Webhooks and click Install.
In the popup window, enter the endpoint you want SamCart to send an HTTP POST to in the box labeled Notify URL, including https://.
Click Connect. You land on the Installed tab of the App Marketplace, which lists every installed app.
Click Webhooks to see the new connection. From the Webhooks page, + Add New Rule sets which events are sent to it.
